requirement: The smart-home IoT controller shall verify a homeowner's credentials against the stored account record before granting access to the device configuration panel.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll and human resources management system must require every department manager to prove their identity with a valid login credential before displaying the salary approval screen.

The database server shall apply a change to any account credential to every service endpoint and node of the server, so that the superseded credential is rejected everywhere at the next login attempt.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll and human resources management system must enforce a reset of an employee's login credential across all of its modules, including the time-sheet and benefits portals, so that identity checks always use the latest credential.
The smart-home IoT controller shall propagate a revoked or updated user credential to all paired hubs and mobile apps so that each one authenticates the user only with the current credential.

The screen capture tool shall end the active recording session and lock the application when no user input has been received for a configurable idle interval, limiting exploitation of an unattended session.

The smart-card electronic purse must close its open transaction session and require a fresh start after the card has been idle for a defined time, so that an abandoned session cannot be abused by an attacker.
The data warehousing system shall terminate any analyst's query session that has shown no activity for a set period, preventing a hijacker from taking over the abandoned connection.
The online banking application must present a challenge that only a human can solve after a series of consecutive failed login attempts, in order to block automated guessing attacks.

The screen capture tool shall require the user to complete a human-verification challenge before accepting further activation-key entries once repeated invalid entries are detected, thereby blocking scripted brute-force attempts.

The simulation software shall demand a solved anti-automation challenge before processing additional remote job submissions from a client that has sent many rejected requests, so that bots cannot flood the service.

The hospital patient-record system shall delegate the verification of each clinician's identity to the hospital's central directory service and shall deny access when that service does not confirm the claimed identity.
The screen capture tool must rely on the enterprise single sign-on provider to confirm who a user is before it unlocks any of its recording features.
The simulation software shall allow only users holding the lead-engineer role to view and to edit the parameters of a scenario, and shall refuse both operations for every other user.
The screen capture tool must permit only the recording's owner to open, and to trim or overwrite, a saved capture, and must deny those actions to all other accounts.
The database server shall verify the identity of each connecting client with a valid credential before opening a session.
The data warehousing system must confirm the claimed identity of every analyst and every scheduled loading job through a verifiable credential before it accepts a connection.
The screen capture tool shall require each user to sign in with an enrolled account and a valid credential before it can be launched on a managed workstation.
The compiler's hosted build service must require every developer to present a valid account credential before it accepts a source file for compilation.
The database server shall permit a connection only after the requesting user has been identified by a registered account and a matching credential.
The sales forecasting system shall reject any analyst login secret whose entropy is lower than 64 bits at the time it is set.
The simulation software must accept a new operator credential only when its estimated strength is at least 64 bits of entropy.
The smart-card electronic purse shall accept a cardholder's PIN or passphrase for card activation only when it provides at least 64 bits of strength.

The hospital patient-record system shall allow a nurse's account to hold an authenticated session on only one workstation at a time and shall reject a second concurrent sign-in with the same credentials.
The data warehousing system must limit each analyst identity to a single authenticated session at any moment, refusing a further login from another client while one is active.

The smart-card electronic purse shall attach a cryptographic checksum to the stored balance and shall reject any balance value whose checksum does not match, so that corruption or tampering is detected.
The screen capture tool must compute a digest of every saved recording and compare it on opening, flagging the file as altered whenever the digests differ.
The data warehousing system shall validate the consistency of each loaded record against its source checksum and shall discard any record that has been modified or damaged in transit.
The database server shall run an anti-malware scanner that inspects uploaded files and backup imports and quarantines any file detected as malicious.
The simulation software must scan every third-party model plug-in for malicious code before loading it and must refuse to load any plug-in flagged as infected.
The sales forecasting system shall continuously monitor its host for malware and intrusion signatures and shall isolate the affected component when a threat is detected.
